message.content: {"label":"sufficient","reason":"Three explicit risk statements are drawn from DoorDash's Risk Factors Summary (passage rank 4) and quoted exactly as text.","supported_requirements":[{"requirement":"Three risks highlighted in DoorDash's Risk Factors Summary include: 1) a history of net losses and profitability concerns; 2) potential adverse effects if Dashers are treated as employees; 3) competition risk.","passage_rank":4,"quote":"We have a history of net losses, we anticipate increasing expenses in the future, and we may not be able to maintain or increase profitability in the future;"} ,{"requirement":"Three risks highlighted in DoorDash's Risk Factors Summary include: 1) a history of net losses and profitability concerns; 2) potential adverse effects if Dashers are treated as employees; 3) competition risk.","passage_rank":4,"quote":"If Dashers are reclassified as employees under federal or state law, our business, financial condition, and results of operations would be adversely affected;"} ,{"requirement":"Three risks highlighted in DoorDash's Risk Factors Summary include: 1) a history of net losses and profitability concerns; 2) potential adverse effects if Dashers are treated as employees; 3) competition risk.","passage_rank":4,"quote":"We face intense competition and if we are unable to compete effectively, our business, financial condition, and results of operations would be adversely affected;"}],"missing_requirements":[],"concerns":[]}
